title: Chicken Supreme with Supreme Sauce, Sautéed Potatoes & Seasonal Vegetables
description: Chicken Supreme is a classic Continental dish featuring succulent chicken breasts served with a rich Supreme sauce, golden sautéed potatoes, and butter-finished seasonal vegetables. This elegant preparation is ideal for fine dining and special occasions.

ingredients.title: For the Chicken Supreme
items: Chicken breasts, supreme cut – 4 pcs (approx. 150 g each)

ingredients.title: Seasonal Vegetables
items: Butter or olive oil – for sautéing

instruction.title: Step 1 – Marinate the Chicken
steps: Trim any excess fat from the chicken supremes.
In a mixing bowl, combine oil, crushed garlic, rosemary, Worcestershire sauce, salt, and pepper.
Rub the marinade onto the chicken, cover, and refrigerate for 1 hour to infuse flavor.

instruction.title: Step 2 – Prepare the Sautéed Potatoes
steps: Boil the potatoes whole in salted water until just tender. Drain and allow to cool.
Peel and slice into uniform roundels (½–1 cm thick).
Heat butter in a sauté pan and cook the potatoes until golden brown on both sides.
Season with salt before serving. Keep warm.

instruction.title: Step 3 – Make the Supreme Sauce
steps: In a small saucepan, reduce the white wine by half over medium heat.
Add the velouté sauce and bring to a gentle simmer.
In a separate bowl, temper the egg yolk with a little of the hot sauce.
Return the tempered yolk to the pan and stir in the cream.
Heat gently (do not boil) until the sauce thickens and coats the back of a spoon.
Finish with lemon juice, salt, and white pepper.
Strain for a smooth finish if desired. Hold warm.

instruction.title: Step 4 – Prepare the Seasonal Vegetables
steps: Blanch firm vegetables (like carrots or beans) in salted water, then shock in ice water to retain color.
Finish all vegetables by light sautéing in butter or olive oil before plating.
Aim for variety in color and shape, such as carrot batons, zucchini ribbons, and bean bundles.

instruction.title: Step 5 – Cook the Chicken
steps: Preheat a griddle or heavy sauté pan. Lightly oil to prevent sticking.
Lightly dredge the marinated chicken in flour, shaking off excess.
Grill or sear chicken over medium heat, skin-side down first, for 5–6 minutes per side, or until golden and fully cooked (internal temp: 74°C / 165°F).
Rest briefly before plating.

instruction.title: Step 6 – Plating & Presentation
steps: Place the chicken supreme at the center of a warm plate.
Spoon or nap the Supreme sauce over the top.
Arrange sautéed potatoes and seasonal vegetables neatly on the side.
Garnish with a rosemary sprig or finely chopped parsley.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Serve with sautéed potatoes and seasonal vegetables.
Pair with White Burgundy or lightly oaked Chardonnay.
For a richer presentation, serve with pomme purée instead of sautéed potatoes.

chefTips: Keep sauce temperature below 82°C (180°F) after adding egg yolk to avoid curdling.
Add sautéed wild mushrooms to the sauce for extra earthiness.
Allow the chicken to rest before slicing to retain its juices.
Blanch and refresh vegetables in ice water to preserve their vibrant color.
